checkpoints.quote: 09:31 NZST**: Errors start appearing in dashboards.
checkpoints.reason: Mentions the 09:31 impact start but never states that OPS-81 deploy occurred at 09:30.

checkpoints.quote: 09:47 NZST**: Monitoring alert fires due to TransferErrorRate exceeding 20%.
checkpoints.reason: Both the 09:47 alert and 09:52 declaration are correctly stated.

checkpoints.quote: 10:31 NZST**: Sam Okafor initiates rollback of the OPS-81 config deploy.
checkpoints.reason: Rollback start, recovery under 1% at 10:42, and resolution at 10:50 are all correctly captured.

checkpoints.quote: Time to Detect**: From the start of errors at 09:31 to the incident declaration at 09:52, it is 21 minutes.
checkpoints.reason: Uses the wrong endpoint (incident declaration instead of the 09:47 alert), giving an incorrect detection time of 21 minutes instead of 16.

checkpoints.quote: Time to Recover**: From the incident declaration at 09:52 to recovery at 10:42, it is 50 minutes.
checkpoints.reason: Uses an unaccepted reference point (declaration time) rather than impact start, detection, or resolution, yielding a figure not matching any acceptable answer.

checkpoints.quote: The root cause was the JWT signing key being rotated in config deploy OPS-81 without updating the key that the Transactions API validates against.
checkpoints.reason: Root cause is stated accurately and matches the ticket.
The analysis never mentions the post-incident review scheduled for 2026-09-16.
The database suggestion is attributed to Priya Nair as her idea, not asserted as the cause by the analysis.
Both time calculations, while conceptually mislabeled, are derived from real timestamp pairs present in the ticket.
